name: Witchlight
description: A beaded luminous stroke written in the air of deep space, and the stroke is a drawing of the track's harmony. A pen tip advances at a governed speed along a heading; the smoothed circle-of-fifths phase (tonalPhaseFifths, circular EMA at 1.5 s) controls only how fast that heading TURNS, clamped so no arc is tighter than 8 % of frame height — so the same code cannot draw a legible figure on one track and a tangle on the next. Each bead freezes the harmonic phase it was laid down at as its hue, so the ribbon's colour banding is the track's colour history; a confirmed turn steps the hue, so a chord change reads as a colour boundary. arousal modulates pen speed by 25 %, and because beads are emitted at a fixed TIME rate their spacing encodes how fast the hand was moving. Each bar downbeat (barPhase01 wrap) SETS one bead — bigger, brighter, permanent — so the ribbon carries a visible chain of bar markers. An age-weighted relaxation pass smooths the live end into a calligraphic stroke and freezes the record past ~4 s. The trail is exactly the last 30 s. A bounded, refractory head burst fires on a bassDev excursion measured against the track's own running level. Backdrop: three parallax star layers (depth rate from spectralCentroid, mapped against its measured 0.04-0.21 band) and one soft violet nebular bloom (hue from valence), with the ribbon visibly dimming the stars behind it. Milkdrop-inspired (D-113); diverges from its source on the dominant motion model, which in the source is a random walk re-seeded on beats.
